_meta.purpose: Manual ground-truth labels for real gym photos, built to measure the live production Gemini equipment-recognition path's (functions/src/ai_equipment_recognition.ts) real accuracy. No ground-truth labels existed anywhere in the repo before this file (core/CURRENT_STATE.md CT1-human-labels: HUMAN_REVIEW_LABELS = 0).
_meta.source_photos: D:\Downloads\Photos-1-001, copied into data/gym_photos_<date>/ (gitignored, pre-existing project convention)
_meta.labeler: Claude (visual inspection), single-annotator -- not cross-checked by a second human. Confidence field reflects how legible/unambiguous the equipment identity is in the photo itself, not model performance.
_meta.privacy_filter: Photos that are people-dominant, personal, or show a minor were excluded from this manifest entirely and are never sent to the Gemini/Vertex AI API for this evaluation.

confidence_levels.HIGH: A legible placard/text label on the machine confirms the category, or the form factor is unambiguous.
confidence_levels.MODERATE: Form factor strongly suggests the category but no legible brand/model text confirms it.
confidence_levels.LOW: Genuine ambiguity even for a human labeler -- multiple machines in frame, or a form factor that plausibly matches 2+ canonical categories.

excluded_unidentifiable.reason: extreme close-up on machine base/frame only, no way to determine equipment category even for a human
